parsed.rationale: V1–V3 (and partly V4) show QS complexes with convex ST elevation of roughly 2–4 mm in contiguous precordial leads. That meets STEMI criteria, so it can't safely be called an old MI from this tracing alone, though a persistent post-infarct aneurysm pattern is possible.
